full_page.content:
Pg. 27. Handwritten Retreats Notes continued.
Thursday
1. REWARD to be kept in mind ETernal, to the human-nay to the created- mind incomprehensibly great .... Eye hath not seen, Ear hath not heard, nor hath it entered into the heart of man to conceive what
"O God! what the glory of Heaven must be When its feeble reflection on mountain and lea Enrobes the dull clay with a beauty sublime. .. Eternity breath on the ashes of time." Fr. E'd's. "Valley of Plains"
II. MARY gentlest, most merciful of tenderest mothers .... next to Jesus- to God most-powerful-our Blessed Mother.
III. MOST HOLY EUCHARIST, Soul of the Church - One holy Mass more than all other Dev. Combined.
IV. God Himself ... My Portion forever. Good to adhere to Him - to make Him my portion indeed & only.
Conclusion near a year after above retreat. 1941
For half an hour approaching Coldwater where we turn South for 70 miles to Ft. Wayne, we wondered more and more at a lake-like cloud ahead. It seemed Just waiting for us, the Sun still smiling over its edge on town and landscape as we turned our course to the left.
It was just beginning to sprinkle and grow dark when before passing last chance for a lunch we decided we'd take coffee, etc ... . Only inside when down it poured blowing door in and flooding floor. Ten minutes more a lull came and with a light sprinkle we were again ready to step on it.
However, it was black as night, save from almost continual lightening, showing a real procession ahead of us and behind .- most solem cannons as it might seem from mountain tops thundering our passage to retreat ..... wonderful! Deo Gratias
Pg. 28. Cont(tinued) cluded.
Driver "Dick" Rogers remarked during our lunch: "I don't mind how heavy it rains but I don't like the wind with it" .... Thank God we could open the win- dows and enjoy the copious though gentle pour till in Ft. Wayne.
We prayed the 15 decades of the Rosary with meditation before each and then from Ft. Wayne to Huntington added five more for safe return to Detroit of benefactor that night.
